cause: One long-lived preflight shell read a concurrently edited runner tail before an in-function slot check existed, so it crossed the benchmark barrier without BENCHMARK_SLOT_GRANTED=95.
recovery: Record the unauthorized start, add an in-function fail-closed slot check, and never infer authorization from preflight state.
correctiveCheck: The runner now requires BENCHMARK_SLOT_GRANTED=95 at both the development entry and model-launch seam; self-test proves a missing slot fails closed.
